entries.name: HYG Database
entries.description: Positions, apparent magnitudes, and B−V colors for the real nearby-star field in /explore's Stellar Neighborhood. Merges the Hipparcos, Yale Bright Star, and Gliese catalogues.
entries.license_rationale: Published by astronexus under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International.

entries.name: GCAT — General Catalog of Space Objects
entries.description: Agency-grade launch log used as the trunk source for the launches calendar — dates, vehicles, and payload records for historical and current spaceflights.
entries.license_rationale: Released by Jonathan C. McDowell under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International; citation is a ship-gate (PRD-020 M14).

entries.name: Launch Library 2 — The Space Devs
entries.description: Upcoming-launch gap-fill aggregator for the launches calendar, used where agency-direct sources do not yet cover a launch. A leaf source, not the trunk (PRD-020).
entries.license_rationale: LL2 terms: free use, attribution encouraged but not mandatory. Always cited regardless, per Orrery editorial discipline.
